pages.quiz:
CREATIVE ARTS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #16
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Singing softly at the end of a lullaby shows (1 mark)
   A. a loud dynamic
   B. a fast tempo
   C. a soft dynamic
   D. a high pitch only

2. When photographing a child, it is good to (1 mark)
   A. stand on a chair
   B. photograph from above only
   C. shout
   D. bend down to their eye level

3. If the bright sun is behind your subject, the subject will (1 mark)
   A. be dark with the face in shadow
   B. be lit clearly
   C. disappear
   D. turn blue

4. In the hawk and the chicks game, the hen (1 mark)
   A. tags everyone
   B. sits down
   C. protects the chicks
   D. chases the hawk away for ever

5. What is a critique? (1 mark)
   A. A kind of drum
   B. An honest, kind talk about someone's work
   C. A rest
   D. A rude remark

6. Blue mixed with red makes (1 mark)
   A. purple
   B. green
   C. orange
   D. yellow

7. The bottom part of the recorder is the (1 mark)
   A. thumb hole
   B. beak
   C. head joint
   D. foot joint

8. Monkey swing helps to develop (1 mark)
   A. only hearing
   B. only counting
   C. balance and coordination
   D. only reading

9. The French rhythm name for a crotchet is (1 mark)
   A. te-te
   B. taa
   C. sh
   D. ta-te

10. Rhythm is (1 mark)
   A. the name of the song
   B. the loudness of the singer
   C. the pattern of long and short sounds
   D. how high a note is

11. What do you add to a colour to make it lighter? (1 mark)
   A. White
   B. Black
   C. Soil
   D. More of the same colour only

12. Which pieces should be pasted first in a montage? (1 mark)
   A. The back pieces
   B. The title only
   C. The smallest pieces
   D. The front pieces

13. A full netball court is divided into how many equal parts? (1 mark)
   A. Four
   B. Six
   C. Two
   D. Three

14. A sequence in gymnastics is (1 mark)
   A. a single balance
   B. a set of movements performed in a fixed order
   C. a type of mat
   D. a rule break

15. A blurred photograph is (1 mark)
   A. dark
   B. always good
   C. very clear
   D. not sharp

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. How do you select the best photographs? (3 marks)

17. Give three examples of good etiquette during a performance. (3 marks)

18. List four steps of the medium start. (4 marks)

19. Why is it important to appreciate the works of people from different cultures? (3 marks)

20. What is a montage? (2 marks)
pages.answers:
CREATIVE ARTS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #16 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. C — a soft dynamic
   Softness is dynamics.

2. D — bend down to their eye level
   Eye level gives a friendly picture.

3. A — be dark with the face in shadow
   The face is in shadow.

4. C — protects the chicks
   The hen blocks the hawk.

5. B — An honest, kind talk about someone's work
   A critique gives fair comments in a respectful way.

6. A — purple
   Blue and red give purple.

7. D — foot joint
   The foot joint ends in the bell.

8. C — balance and coordination
   Moving side to side lightly needs balance.

9. B — taa
   Taa is the name for one long sound in one beat.

10. C — the pattern of long and short sounds
   Rhythm is the pattern of sounds over the beat.

11. A — White
   White makes a tint, a lighter tone.

12. A — The back pieces
   You paste the back ones first and then those in front.

13. D — Three
   A netball court is divided into three equal thirds.

14. B — a set of movements performed in a fixed order
   A sequence links skills one after the other.

15. D — not sharp
   Blurred means not sharp.

SECTION B
----
16. (3 marks)
   Answer: Check for good light, a clear subject, sharpness and no distractions, and delete the poor ones.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

17. (3 marks)
   Answer: Walk on and off quietly, listen to the leader, do not talk or laugh, clap for others, bow at the end. Any three.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

18. (4 marks)
   Answer: Front foot about one and a half foot lengths behind the line; kneel on the rear knee level with the middle of the front foot; hands behind the line shoulder-width apart; on set, lift the hips a little above the shoulders.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each step.

19. (3 marks)
   Answer: We learn about others, it builds respect and unity and it helps us value all cultures.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

20. (2 marks)
   Answer: A picture made by joining many cut pictures or pieces of material on a background.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for many pieces, 1 mark for joined on a background.
